name: binder
description: Binder — десктопный биндер отыгровок для RP-серверов (GTA/SAMP и др.)
author: Binder

scripts.build:native: npm --prefix native install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix native run build
scripts.build:win: npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.release: npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
